svg.aria-label: A chalkboard lecture. Board one: distributed systems 101, an owner with five workers wired to it, a single point of failure; the owner is crossed out, and everyone goes down. The board is erased. Board two: fix, connect every worker; the five workers are linked to each other and the links form a red star. K5 equals a star, no single point of failure, a comrade crashes and the rest carry on. Workers of the world, unite!
